T: Keep the windows shut. Keep the crab coming.
D: A San Francisco socialite follows a man to a seaside town where the birds start attacking.
P: Serve the crab when Melanie sits down at the restaurant in Bodega Bay.
S: Crab with mayo, lemon and chives piled on garlic rubbed sourdough toasts
Crab meat folded with a little mayo, lemon, chives and a pinch of cayenne, piled on toasted sourdough rubbed with garlic.
the children's birthday party on the hill

Poached chicken folded with mayo, celery, toasted walnuts, grapes and tarragon, in soft white bread cut into party triangles. Poach 2 chicken breasts in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, cool and shred finely. Mix with 5 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 finely diced celery sticks, 40g chopped toasted walnuts, a handful of halved green grapes, 1 tbsp chopped tarragon, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper. Butter 12 slices of soft white bread and fill 6 sandwiches. Trim the crusts and cut each into 4 triangles.
Crisp filo cups filled with whipped goat's cheese
Little pastry nests of filo baked at 180C until crisp, filled with whipped goat's cheese, a few peas and a mint leaf, two to a plate.
M: Seafood stew of mussels, clams and fish in a tomato and white wine broth
Onion, fennel and garlic cooked in olive oil, tomato, white wine and fish stock simmered 20 minutes, mussels, clams, prawns and white fish added in turns. Sourdough.
Lydia's roast chicken with sage stuffing

Golden roast chicken filled with a sage, onion and bread stuffing, with roast potatoes, glazed carrots and a pan gravy made from the drippings. Heat the oven to 200C. Soften 1 diced onion in 40g butter, then mix with 150g fresh breadcrumbs, chopped sage, 1 egg, salt and pepper. Stuff a 1.8kg chicken, rub with butter and salt and roast with 1kg halved potatoes tossed in oil for 1 hour 20 minutes. Glaze 500g sliced carrots in a pan with butter, 1 tbsp honey and a splash of water. Rest the chicken 15 minutes, stir 1 tbsp flour and 250ml stock into the tray for gravy.
W: Crisp meringue nests filled with lemon curd and topped with speckled candy eggs
Meringue piped into little nests, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, filled with lemon curd and topped with speckled chocolate eggs.
K: Hot coffee with Irish whiskey and brown sugar, topped with floating cream
Hot coffee with brown sugar and 30ml Irish whiskey, lightly whipped cream floated on top.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the crab filling up to 1 day ahead, kept chilled; toast the sourdough and pile on at the last minute

steps.text: Fold the crab with mayo, lemon juice, chives and cayenne.
Toast the sourdough and rub with the cut garlic.
Pile the crab on top and serve straight away.

veg.n: Bodega Bay hearts of palm toasts
veg.make_ahead: Shred and mix the hearts of palm filling up to 1 day ahead, chilled; toast and assemble just before serving

steps.text: Shred the hearts of palm with a fork, pat dry and fold with mayo, lemon juice, chives, cayenne and the nori crumbled fine.
Toast the sourdough and rub with the cut garlic.
Pile the hearts of palm on top and serve straight away.

dishes.make_ahead: Cases up to 1 day ahead, fill just before serving

steps.text: Cut the filo into squares and brush with melted butter.
Press in layers into a mini muffin tin.
Bake at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp.
Fill with whipped goat's cheese, peas and a mint leaf. Serve two to a plate.

dishes.make_ahead: Simmer the tomato, wine and stock base up to 2 days ahead, chilled; reheat and cook the seafood on the night

steps.text: Soften the onion, fennel and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes, wine and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the mussels and clams, cover and cook until they open.
Add the prawns and snapper and cook just until done. Serve with sourdough.

af.make_ahead: Make the tomato and stock base up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; bring back to a simmer and add the seafood to serve

steps.text: Soften the onion, fennel and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes, stock and lemon juice and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the mussels and clams, cover and cook until they open.
Add the prawns and snapper and cook just until done. Serve with sourdough.

veg.make_ahead: Make the base and brown the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead, kept chilled; reheat, add the beans and tofu and serve

steps.text: Soften the onion, fennel and garlic in 2 tbsp of the oil.
Add the tomatoes, wine, stock and nori and simmer for 20 minutes.
Brown the mushrooms in the remaining oil in a separate pan and add to the pot with the beans.
Add the tofu and simmer gently until heated through. Serve with sourdough.

veg_af.make_ahead: Simmer the tomato and stock base up to 2 days ahead, covered in the fridge; reheat with the mushrooms, beans and tofu on the night

steps.text: Soften the onion, fennel and garlic in 2 tbsp of the oil.
Add the tomatoes, all the stock, the lemon juice and nori and simmer for 20 minutes.
Brown the mushrooms in the remaining oil in a separate pan and add to the pot with the beans.
Add the tofu and simmer gently until heated through. Serve with sourdough.

dishes.make_ahead: Nests up to 2 days ahead, airtight

steps.text: Whisk the egg whites and sugar over simmering water until hot, then beat to stiff peaks.
Pipe small nests onto lined trays.
Bake at 100C for 90 minutes, then cool.
Fill with lemon curd and top each with three speckled eggs.

dishes.make_ahead: Best made fresh and hot; whip the cream lightly up to 4 hours ahead and keep it chilled

steps.text: Brew the coffee with the water.
For each glass stir sugar into hot coffee with whiskey.
Pour the cream over the back of a spoon so it floats.

af.make_ahead: Brew the coffee fresh; the cream can be whipped earlier in the day and kept chilled

steps.text: Brew the coffee and warm the glasses with a little of the hot water.
Lightly whip the cream until just thick but still pourable.
Tip out the water. For each glass stir sugar and a few drops of vanilla into hot coffee.
Pour the cream over the back of a spoon so it floats.

s.note: Crab with mayo, lemon and chives piled on garlic rubbed sourdough toasts
s.how: Fold 250g crab meat with 2 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, chopped chives and a pinch of cayenne. Toast 8 small slices of sourdough and rub with a cut garlic clove. Pile the crab on top and serve straight away.

s.note: Crisp filo cups filled with whipped goat's cheese
s.how: Cut 4 sheets filo into squares, brush with 40g melted butter and press into a mini muffin tin in layers. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp. Fill with 120g whipped goat's cheese, a few blanched peas and a mint leaf. Serve two to a plate.

m.note: Seafood stew of mussels, clams and fish in a tomato and white wine broth
m.how: Soften an onion, a fennel bulb and 3 garlic cloves in oil. Add a tin of tomatoes, 250ml white wine and 500ml fish stock and simmer 20 minutes. Add 500g mussels and 500g clams, then 300g prawns and 300g snapper. Serve with sourdough.

w.note: Crisp meringue nests filled with lemon curd and topped with speckled candy eggs
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites and 180g sugar over simmering water until hot, then beat to stiff peaks. Pipe 8 small nests and bake at 100C for 90 minutes. Cool, fill with lemon curd and top each with three speckled chocolate eggs.

d.note: Hot coffee with Irish whiskey and brown sugar, topped with floating cream
d.how: Brew 60g coffee with 1L water. For each glass, stir 2 tsp brown sugar into 150ml hot coffee with 30ml Irish whiskey. Pour 200ml lightly whipped cream over the back of a spoon so it floats.
